verdicts.reason: A puts an oversized 'Shop Flavours' CTA hard against the left edge, ahead of the headline, so the action outweighs the message and the reading order runs backwards. The tagline wraps into an orphaned 'long season.', the flavour pills are in reverse order and jammed into one row, and the legal text sits in a big dead zone on the right. B gets the banner order right (headline on the left, CTA on the right), but the headline, SOLSTICE and the pills are jammed against the left edge, and the tagline runs straight into the legal text, which reads as one long line of copy. The pills are still in reverse order, and the middle and right of the canvas are mostly empty.
